summary: Connect SLOs, secure delivery controls and cloud-native evidence. Review practical scenarios and build a service assurance action plan.
lede: Cloud-native SRE and DevSecOps practices connect service reliability with secure delivery controls and assurance evidence. For SREs, platform engineers and security assurance specialists, the training covers defining service indicators and objectives, interpreting telemetry and error budgets, reviewing Kubernetes recovery evidence, and tracing build provenance and software-bill-of-materials records. Learners apply these skills to release and incident decisions and consolidate evidence in service assurance reviews.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who connect cloud-native production services with delivery controls, reliability targets and assurance evidence. It suits intermediate practitioners who already work with software delivery or cloud operations and need to make cross-functional release and incident decisions using consistent artefacts.
modules: SRE Service Ownership and SLO Design
prerequisites: Prior experience in software delivery, cloud operations, site reliability engineering or security assurance is expected. You should be comfortable with basic cloud-native service concepts and delivery workflows. No programming is required; exercises focus on reviewing sample metrics, policy artefacts and evidence records.
